summary: HealthStream filed an 8-K reporting entry into the Second Amendment to its Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement, dated September 10, 2026, among the Company as borrower, domestic subsidiaries as guarantors, lenders, and Truist Bank as administrative agent. The amendment extends the $50 million unsecured revolver, with $5 million swingline and letter-of-credit sublimits and a $25 million accordion, to a September 10, 2031 maturity. Pricing is SOFR plus 1.50% or base rate plus 0.50%, leverage-based. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
